title: Why Japan's Conviction Rate is 99% (Actually Explained)
summary: Yuta explains what Japan's 99% conviction rate actually means, noting that prosecutors drop cases unless confidence is very high. He argues that the number is widely misunderstood and cites his sources.
why: Recommended as a sourced, nuanced corrective whenever the Japanese justice system's conviction rate is raised.

quote.text: I've seen this Japanese person explaining the situation informally but thoroughly.
